name: crewmeld
description: CrewMeld — Enterprise AI Digital Workforce Platform. Manage AI employees like real team members. Visual SOP orchestration, 13 LLM providers (including China-native models), 8+ messaging channels(WeCom/DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), knowledge base with RAG, and full private deployment support. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript & Bun.
